items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: He did a string date for me years ago, in May '64

ctx.x: He did a string date for me years ago, in May '64, and we talked the whole day on the phone, and I walked in the studio just like the string players, and he had the piano part for me to play -- and they played strings and it was just like putting on an old shoe.
